title: Zero divisors in group algebras of torsion-free groups in odd characteristic
summary: A recent preprint constructs a finitely presented torsion-free group $G$ with a finite two-dimensional classifying space such that $\mathbb F_2[G]$ contains nonzero zero divisors. We extend this to every odd prime $p$: there is a finitely presented torsion-free group $G_p$, again with a finite two-dimensional classifying space, such that $\mathbb F_p[G_p]$ contains nonzero elements $α,β$ with $αβ=0$.
